title: Smooth-center blowups and reduced strict transforms
statement: Let $P$ be smooth, separated and of finite type over $\mathbf Q$, and let $C\hookrightarrow P$ be a smooth closed subscheme [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms, def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Then $P^+=\operatorname{Bl}_C(P)$ [def-nagata-global-blowup] is smooth, separated and of finite type over $\mathbf Q$. The empty center is allowed. If $X\hookrightarrow P$ is any reduced closed subscheme [def-pc-reduced-scheme], its scheme-theoretic strict transform in $P^+$ is reduced [def-nagata-strict-transform]. These assertions do not require the center to be a maximum stratum or to be contained in $X$.

source.place: Tag 0FUT, more-morphisms.tex lemma-blowup; Tag 02NS, divisors.tex lemma-blowing-up-projective; reduced strict transform follows directly from scheme-theoretic closure of the reduced open complement.

proof.text: Put $k=\mathbf Q$ and $b_P:P^+\to P$. Apply [lem-trf-smooth-pair-blowup-local-models] with $R=k$. It supplies a finite-type quasi-coherent center ideal, a finite-presentation center, and, near every point of $C$, an open $V$ whose inverse image is etale over a coordinate-subspace model. Apply [lem-trf-coordinate-subspace-blowup-charts] to this etale morphism: $b_P^{-1}(V)$ is smooth over $k$, including when the model is empty.

source.place: Tag 0FUE, lemma-etale-local-structure, and Tag 0FUT, lemma-blowup, final proof paragraph; divisors.tex Tag 0805, lemma-flat-base-change-blowing-up. Local-model and finite-presentation portion only.

proof.text: Over $U=P\setminus C$, [thm-nagata-global-blowup-complement] identifies $b_P^{-1}(U)$ with $U$, smooth by restriction and isomorphism invariance [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-restrict-open-subschemes]. These opens and those of step 1 cover $P^+$. Thus [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-local-on-source] gives smoothness. If $C=\varnothing$, the complement isomorphism covers all of $P^+$.

source.place: Tag 0FUT, lemma-blowup, smoothness conclusion; divisors.tex Tag 0807, lemma-blowing-up-gives-effective-Cartier-divisor, complement assertion.

proof.text: The finite-type quasi-coherent ideal from step 1 makes $b_P$ proper by [lemma-nagata-blowup-proper], hence separated and of finite type by [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Compose with the given finite-type map $P\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ using [lem-sfb-finite-type-composition-base-change](1). Therefore $P^+$ is of finite type over $k$; properness of $P$ over $k$ is not needed.

source.place: Tag 02NS, lemma-blowing-up-projective, in particular properness; morphisms.tex Tag 01T3, lemma-composition-finite-type.

proof.text: Factor the diagonal as $P^+\to P^+\times_PP^+\to P^+\times_kP^+$. The first arrow is closed since $b_P$ is separated [def-weil-proper-morphism]; the second is the base change of the closed diagonal of $P$, hence closed by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-base-change]. Their composite is closed: affine quotient ring surjections compose, as do closed embeddings [def-weil-closed-immersion]. This proves separatedness over $k$.

source.place: Tag 01KU, lemma-separated-permanence(1), diagonal factorization written out; morphisms.tex Tag 01QR, lemma-base-change-closed-immersion.

proof.text: For reduced $X\hookrightarrow P$, put $X_U=X\times_PU$. Its local rings are those of $X$, so $X_U$ is reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. The complement isomorphism [thm-nagata-global-blowup-complement] identifies the open $T=X_U\times_U(P^+\times_PU)$ of $Y=X\times_PP^+$ with $X_U$. Its scheme-theoretic closure in $Y$ is the strict transform [def-nagata-strict-transform], since step 1 gives the required finite-presentation center. By [lem-trf-reduced-scheme-image] this closure is the reduced induced structure on $\overline{|T|}$. Also $Y\to P^+$ is closed by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-base-change]. The closure in $Y$ is closed in $P^+$; conversely every closed subscheme of $P^+$ containing $T$ pulls back to one of $Y$ containing $T$. Minimality of schematic closure identifies the two closures. Hence the strict transform inside $P^+$ is reduced, also for $T=\varnothing$ or $X\subseteq C$. No containment $C\subseteq X$ or stratum hypothesis was used.

source.place: Tag 056B, lemma-scheme-theoretic-image-reduced, applied to the strict-transform open immersion of divisors.tex Tag 080D, definition-strict-transform.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0FUT, lemma-blowup, following Tag 0FUE and the explicit coordinate calculation of Tag 0H1H; reducedness is morphisms.tex Tag 056B; properness is the blowup consequence of divisors.tex Tag 02NS.
